name: frontend-engineering-standard
description: Configurable repository rule checks, change-impact analysis, and evidence-based pull-request review.

interface.shortDescription: Configurable rule checks, impact analysis, and PR review
interface.longDescription: A read-only engineering assistant that combines deterministic repository checks with evidence-based impact analysis and pull-request review. Project-specific conventions are supplied through repository instructions or an optional .ai-marketplace.json file.
defaultPrompt: Check my current changes against this repository's rules.
Analyze the applications, packages, risks, and tests affected by this change.
Review the current diff and report only evidence-backed issues.
